component.name: openmotion-bl (open-motion-sensor-bl)
component.description: Open-Motion secure bootloader for STM32H743 (X-CUBE-SBSFU port, USB DFU). Build type Release with the hardware protections enabled. Shared 512 KB slot layout (sectors 1-4, anti-rollback floor in sector 5); the console and sensor bootloaders are one source kept identical in two repositories, differing in the signing key only.

properties.name: openwater:license-status
properties.value: no LICENSE file at this commit (console: LICENSE exists on main since 3241326, not yet merged into the branch)

properties.name: openwater:security-configuration
properties.value: Release preset (SBSFU_ENABLE_PROTECTIONS=ON, CMakePresets.json): the bootloader programs WRP on sector 0, PCROP on the Secure Engine key region (0x08000600-0x080008FF) and RDP level 1 at its first boot (SECBOOT_OB_DEV_MODE) and applies DAP and DMA protection; MPU isolation off by design (application runs privileged; SE key RAM is zeroized on exit); RDP level 2 (SFU_FINAL_SECURE_LOCK_ENABLE) not enabled, pending the T2 production-lock decision. Debug preset: development mode, option bytes untouched.

properties.name: openwater:in-tree-not-compiled
properties.value: KMS 1.2.3, STSAFE_A1xx 3.3.7, STM32_WPAN 1.13.0, other-family cryptolib binaries, Secure Engine Utilities/KeysAndImages

properties.name: openwater:dfu-update-path
properties.value: Signed header is verified (Secure Engine ECDSA, version >= installed, size) before the installed image is erased; refused downloads leave the device bootable. Out-of-window DFU reads return zeros.

properties.name: openwater:trace-output
properties.value: None in Release builds (DEBUG_ENABLED is Debug-only).
